name: ReportDuty
description: Use only when the NPC is the player's superior in the guard and the player has just come back to report on the duty they were given. Records the report; the server checks it against whether anyone saw the player at their post. Do not use it for small talk about the duty.
note: Living World guard duties (MANTELLA_LIVING_WORLD=1). Handled by the Living World server (livingworld/guard/duty.py), which applies the guard's own rules; nothing happens in the game.
prompt: If the player is reporting back to you on the guard duty you gave them, begin your response with '{key}:'
